# Third-party assets

Pinned, locally served distributions downloaded from jsDelivr/unpkg:

| Library | Version | Upstream / license |
|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap — MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | https://github.com/twbs/icons — MIT |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet — BSD-2-Clause |
| Leaflet.draw | 1.0.4 | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.draw — MIT |

Copyright notices embedded in distribution files are retained. See upstream LICENSE files for full terms before redistribution. Leaflet tile attribution links to OpenStreetMap contributors. Tiles are loaded from `https://tile.openstreetmap.org/` only; library code, icon fonts and drawing sprites are served locally.
